# Public ground-truth sample: PHerc. Paris 4 (Scroll 1), human-verified patches + centre line + winding numbers, 9.6 um grid

Licence: CC BY-NC 4.0 (Vesuvius Challenge open data; see https://scrollprize.org/data). Non-commercial test sample only.

Spiral dataset: https://vesuvius-challenge-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com/PHercParis4/representations/spiral/20260411134726-spiral-dataset-20261019084150/ (coordinates in 9.6 um voxels = level 2 of the 2.4 um scan https://vesuvius-challenge-open-data.s3.amazonaws.com/PHercParis4/volumes/20260411134726-2.400um-0.2m-78keV-masked.zarr; CT level-2 shape [18946, 8174, 8174]).
Verified patches: 40 of 22563 chosen by seed 20261105 (every 141th folder, then the first 40 with a window under 768 px and at least 100 valid cells, up to 22 MB). Every patch is a human-verified correct trace: a trace checker should PASS all of them.
Per patch: mesh.tifxyz (x/y/z shifted by the window origin, mask applied, zlib), slices/ (CT level 2, 8-bit) and surfpred/ (m7 surface prediction L2 th0.2, 8-bit, higher = more papyrus-like) at three heights through the patch; the window and heights are in meta.json.
umbilicus_9p6um.json: the spiral dataset's centre line on this grid. umbilicus_2p4um.json: the published centre line on the 2.4 um grid (divide x,y,z by 4 for this grid). abs_winding.json: absolute winding number per annotated point (VC3D collection format, this grid).
